items.title: Everything in one More menu
items.body: Tap the three dots on the video to watch on TV, share the live with a QR code, or invite viewers when the host allows it.

items.title: Share with a QR code
items.body: A share card shows the event, a QR code anyone can scan, and quick buttons for WhatsApp, other apps, saving the QR and your TV.

items.title: Host, Gift and Like under the video
items.body: The host and the title sit right under the video, with Gift and Like next to them.

releases.title: Watch a live event on your TV

items.title: Watch on TV for everyone
items.body: The live screen now has a Watch on TV button at the top right of the video, also when you are not signed in. Tap it to send the live to a paired TV, or sign in to pair one.

releases.title: Live events: the host, and wishes for guests

items.title: The real host name
items.body: A live event now shows the name of the person hosting it, instead of a generic label, on both the live screen and the guest screen.

items.title: Wishes and invites without an account
items.body: Guests watching a live event now have a Wishes & Memories tab beside the live chat. Send a video or text wish, share the invite link or QR code, and read the wishes the host approved.

items.title: Send a video wish
items.body: Recording a one-minute video wish no longer fails with a message about reading a photo. The clip now uploads straight from your phone.

items.title: Cleaner wish form
items.body: An old error no longer stays on screen while you type your wish.

items.title: RWF instead of RF
items.body: Amounts now start with the currency code, such as RWF 5,000, the same way packages and bookings already do. This applies wherever prices, balances and checkout totals are shown.
